# istanbul-lib-source-maps

[![Build Status](https://example.invalid/istanbuljs/istanbuljs.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/istanbuljs/istanbuljs)

Source map support for istanbuljs.

## Debugging

_istanbul-lib-source-maps_ uses the [debug](https://example.invalid/package/debug) module.
Run your application with the environment variable `DEBUG=istanbuljs`, to receive debug
output.
